historical_label_availability_by_round.decision: This round's quantitative rule comparison (evaluate-rules.py) uses S4 alone as the labeled design corpus. The authorization's suggested Option B (leave-one-round-out across S1/S2/S3/S4) could not be implemented as specified because S1-S3 predate the machine-readable ledger convention S4 introduced and do not support reliable, non-fragile per-PR label extraction at the same standard. This is a real, disclosed methodological constraint of the historical record, not a shortcut taken for convenience.
